purpose: Cases the real 2026-08-19 capture does not contain. Every file also carries the same one-line note inline, except the two whose shape cannot hold an extra key (torn-route-4.json is deliberately unparseable).

fixtures.after-midnight-tripupdate.json: Silent failure 5: GTFS clock 25:10:00 must resolve to 01:10 the next calendar day, not be rejected as an invalid hour.
fixtures.dst-spring-forward-20260308.json: Silent failure 3: 23-hour service day; the anchor is noon-minus-12h (23:00 on 03-07), not local midnight.
fixtures.dst-fall-back-20261101.json: Silent failure 3: 25-hour service day; 01:00-01:59 local repeats and the anchor is 01:00 CDT, not local midnight.
fixtures.stale-shard-route-4.json: Silent failure 1: shard built from an older GTFS feed version, so no live trip id matches; the unmatched rate must alarm.
fixtures.vehicle-without-trip-update.json: Decision-table row 3: vehicle with a position but no trip update -> unknown/no_trip_update.
fixtures.canceled-trip-no-stop-updates.json: Decision-table row 2: CANCELED trip with no stopTimeUpdate at all -> unknown/trip_canceled.
fixtures.vehicle-null-current-stop-sequence.json: Decision-table row 6b: in-service vehicle with no currentStopSequence -> unknown/no_progress.
fixtures.frozen-feed-response.json: Silent failure 2: upstream returns HTTP 200 with a header timestamp 4h07m old; freshness must come from the timestamp, not the status code.
fixtures.route-4-dead-cron.json: Silent failure 2 / criterion 8: last-good route file served 47 minutes after the cron died; suppress_adherence true, every vehicle unknown/stale_data.
fixtures.torn-route-4.json: Section 11: a route file truncated mid-write. Deliberately not valid JSON, so it carries no inline comment. Proves the client survives a torn read and that atomic rename is what prevents it.
fixtures.all-buses-fleet.json: The all-buses view: a 19-vehicle trim of the real 2026-08-19 capture carrying every adherence state, deadheads both moving and parked, and two buses sharing a route so route grouping is exercised. counts recomputed for the trim.
fixtures.departures-800.json: Saved trips: the four southbound route 800 trips serving stop 6293 (Simond SB) between 07:30 and 08:30 on 20260819, and every stop they make. 6293 is a MINOR stop, not a timepoint, which is why the route payload alone cannot resolve a watch. Includes trip 3010894_22201 at 07:52:09, the API contract's own watch example.
fixtures.departures-4-turnaround.json: The stops view at a turnaround: route 4 stop 6243 Campbell/5th on 20260819, where westbound arrives as its last stop and eastbound leaves as its first. Four eastbound departures between 15:00 and 16:00 with the four westbound legs that feed them, paired by block_id. A board that only looks for eastbound vehicles here shows an empty stop, which is the blank this fixture exists to catch.
fixtures.departures-837-turnaround-canceled.json: A turnaround that also carries a cancellation and low-confidence blocks: route 837 stop 2112, 5th/Guadalupe (Republic Square), on 20260819. Six northbound departures between 10:00 and 11:00, one of which CapMetro canceled, plus the southbound legs that feed them. Every 837 block in this capture is confidence "low", so a card stating the continuation as fact here would be stating a guess as fact - contract section 4 forbids it and this fixture is where that is proved.
fixtures.chain-800-to-4.json: Transfer chains: the 07:52:09 route 800 SB from Simond SB (6293) and the route 4 buses it can reach, trimmed from real generated output by generate-chain-fixture.mjs. Routes 800 and 4 share ZERO stop ids — they meet at Pleasant Valley where the MetroRapid platform and the local kerb are tens of metres apart under different ids — so a transfer found by intersecting stop ids finds nothing here. The suite asserts that shared count is 0 so the premise cannot rot silently.

conventions._comment: one-line note naming the failure this fixture encodes
conventions._expected: the values an implementation must produce from this fixture; assertions read from here so the fixture and the test cannot drift
conventions._now: the observer clock the test should use, so no test depends on the wall clock
conventions.underscore_prefix: test metadata, not part of any wire format; strip keys beginning with _ before schema validation
